import csv
ts="54bac0b6-bd85-5aca-861a-0399d378e5cc"
rows=[]
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r["timeseries_id"]==ts:
            rows.append((r["timestamp"],float(r["value"])))
rows.sort()
day=[v for t,v in rows if t.startswith("2018-10-13")]
print(len(day), max(day) if day else None)
print(any(v>3190 for v in day))
